headline: Chiefs defense stops the Colts
what_happened: On third down, which is the third of four chances to move the ball, the quarterback D.Jones ran but was forced out of bounds after gaining only five yards.
who: D.Jones ran, and J.Hicks made the tackle for Kansas City.
why_it_matters: This is great news for our Chiefs! By stopping the Colts from getting closer to a touchdown, the Colts' chances of winning the game have dropped by 7 percentage points.
